items.title: Randy Sandke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: I mean there are players like Dave Douglas, you know a very fine trumpet player

ctx.x: To help to grab a young audience.

Well yeah, yeah. And that’s happening. I mean there are players like Dave Douglas, you know a very fine trumpet player who is really starting, just beginning to get the attention he deserves, and he’s kind of associated with that Knitting Factory crowd, which has been kind of on the fringe, but some of that stuff is getting very sophisticated, some of the musicians who do it are terrific and they’re really doing some interesting things. I mean that’s just to name one example, I mean there are other people around…
Well you started out with some influence from your older brother?
